source_refs.note: 'Building a Simple Predictive Model' under topic 6.6, as printed (PDF 84-85, printed 80-81).

blocks.text: A simple predictive model uses basic algorithms to learn from training data. It analyses the data to understand patterns and then makes predictions for new, unseen data. These models are easy to understand and are especially helpful for beginners. Their performance is measured using test data and the results guide improvements.
